description: Bata Pakistan Limited is a footwear manufacturer and retailer incorporated in Pakistan in 1951 as Bata Shoe Company (Pakistan) Limited, which went public in 1979. It has been selling in Pakistan since 1942, manufactures footwear for all segments and sells accessories and hosiery, through more than 500 retail outlets, registered wholesale dealers and sales offices across the country, and also exports. Its parent is Bafin B.V. (Netherlands) and the ultimate parent is Compass Limited, Bermuda.
sourceNote: Company website (bata.com.pk: about us) and the PSX Data Portal company record for BATA, read 2026-10-17.
